subject: Romag
fact: Romag is the leader who explains that the Temple of Elemental Evil was founded on the principle that the true nature of the universe is constant chaos between the elements, with earth destined to reduce all things to dirt, and that the four elemental temples aligned to unify their ambitions and destroy their enemies.
source_quote: He explained that the Temple of Elemental Evil was founded on the principle that the true nature of the universe is constant chaos between the elements, with earth destined to reduce all things to dirt. The four elemental temples—earth, fire, water, and air—aligned to unify their ambitions and destroy their enemies, planning to settle their differences only after achieving victory.

subject: Emory Meadows
fact: Emory Meadows is the site of the battle where the forces of the temple were defeated by the Archbishop of Veluna and the Kingdom of Furyondy, and where the Circle of Eight locked the temple itself, blocking access to the central driving power.
source_quote: The forces of the temple had united and marched out to conquer, but they were defeated at the Battle of Emory Meadows by the Archbishop of Veluna and the Kingdom of Furyondy. The Circle of Eight, including powerful wizards like Bigby, Tenser, and Mordenkainen, had shown up and locked the temple itself, blocking access to the central driving power that gave them their necessary energy.

subject: Bigby
fact: Bigby is one of the powerful wizards in the Circle of Eight who showed up at Emory Meadows and locked the temple, blocking access to its central driving power.
source_quote: The Circle of Eight, including powerful wizards like Bigby, Tenser, and Mordenkainen, had shown up and locked the temple itself, blocking access to the central driving power that gave them their necessary energy.

subject: Tenser
fact: Tenser is one of the powerful wizards in the Circle of Eight who showed up at Emory Meadows and locked the temple, blocking access to its central driving power.
source_quote: The Circle of Eight, including powerful wizards like Bigby, Tenser, and Mordenkainen, had shown up and locked the temple itself, blocking access to the central driving power that gave them their necessary energy.

subject: Mordenkainen
fact: Mordenkainen is one of the powerful wizards in the Circle of Eight who showed up at Emory Meadows and locked the temple, blocking access to its central driving power.
source_quote: The Circle of Eight, including powerful wizards like Bigby, Tenser, and Mordenkainen, had shown up and locked the temple itself, blocking access to the central driving power that gave them their necessary energy.

subject: the Orb
fact: The Orb is the only object capable of forcing the chaotic elements to submit to the stability of earth, the shackle that binds the storm and flood, and the tool to impose the discipline of stone upon the reckless factions of fire and water.
source_quote: He revealed that the key was an orb, the only object capable of forcing the chaotic elements to submit to the stability of earth. It was the shackle that binds the storm and flood, the tool to impose the discipline of stone upon the reckless factions of fire and water.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch sent word of a group of professional mercenaries called the Broken Blades currently being recruited in Nulb, and arranged a meeting with their captain, Dren Halveth, to discuss recruitment.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch had sent word of a group of professional mercenaries called the Broken Blades currently being recruited in Nulb. Dick arranged a meeting with Dren Halveth...

subject: Dren Halveth
fact: Dren Halveth is the half-orc captain of the Broken Blades, with broad shoulders, scars, and one ruined white eye, whose crew hung back behind him, relaxed but dangerous, with fingers drifting near weapons.
source_quote: Dren Halveth, a half-orc with broad shoulders, scars, and one ruined white eye. His crew hung back behind him, relaxed but dangerous, with fingers drifting near weapons.

subject: Crimson Reapers
fact: The Crimson Reapers are a group that occupies the room next door to the Broken Blades, stole a shipment of weapons from Dren, and claim the chest is temple property, demanding Dren join their organization or die by midnight.
source_quote: A tattooed and scarred Crimson Reaper opened the door and became angry when Calmer asked about the chest. When Calmer revealed he worked for the Earth Temple, the Reaper explained that the chest was temple property that Dren had stolen. He stated that Dren had until midnight to join the temple or he and his crew would be dead.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is the party member who knocked on the door of the Crimson Reapers to negotiate about the stolen weapons, revealing he worked for the Earth Temple.
source_quote: Calmer was sent to knock on their door while the rest of the party hid nearby. A tattooed and scarred Crimson Reaper opened the door and became angry when Calmer asked about the chest. When Calmer revealed he worked for the Earth Temple...

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia countered the skepticism of Dren Halveth by arguing that the Water Temple relied on propaganda and lies while the Earth Temple showed real commitment by coming to recruit them personally.
source_quote: Sequoia countered brilliantly, arguing that the Water Temple relied on propaganda and lies while the Earth Temple showed real commitment by coming to recruit them personally.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia noticed that Wat, the barkeep at the Watersteide Hostel, looked very unhappy about the Broken Blades joining the Earth Temple, confirming their suspicion that he worked for the Water Temple.
source_quote: Zinnia noticed that Wat, the barkeep, looked very unhappy about the outcome, confirming their suspicion that he worked for the Water Temple.

subject: Wat
fact: Wat is the barkeep at the Watersteide Hostel who appeared unhappy about the Broken Blades joining the Earth Temple and later whispered something to Dren before being shoved away.
source_quote: Wat approached Dren and whispered something to him, but Dren shoved him away.

subject: Watersteide Hostel
fact: The Watersteide Hostel is a run-down establishment in Nulb with a sign reading 'Rooms are cheap, lives cheaper,' where the party met Dick Rentsch and arranged to meet Dren Halveth.
source_quote: The party traveled to Nulb, arriving discreetly at the Watersteide Hostel, a run-down establishment with a sign reading 'Rooms are cheap, lives cheaper.'

subject: Nulb
fact: Nulb is the town where the Broken Blades are being recruited, and where the Watersteide Hostel is located, with competing recruitment efforts from the Earth and Water Temples.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch had sent word of a group of professional mercenaries called the Broken Blades currently being recruited in Nulb.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is one of the party members toasted by Romag for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power, specifically for brilliant counter-arguments that secured the Broken Blades.
source_quote: Romag proposed a toast to Sequoia, Zephyr, Zinnia, and Calmer for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power...

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is one of the party members toasted by Romag for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power.
source_quote: Romag proposed a toast to Sequoia, Zephyr, Zinnia, and Calmer for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power...

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is one of the party members toasted by Romag for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power, specifically for noticing Wat's loyalty to the Water Temple.
source_quote: Romag proposed a toast to Sequoia, Zephyr, Zinnia, and Calmer for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power...

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is one of the party members toasted by Romag for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power, specifically for his conversion from a cleric of St. Cuthbert to a follower of the elder elemental god.
source_quote: Romag proposed a toast to Sequoia, Zephyr, Zinnia, and Calmer for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power, specifically highlighting Calmer's conversion from a cleric of St. Cuthbert to a follower of the elder elemental god.

subject: banquet hall
fact: The banquet hall is the newly cleaned room where Romag hosted a celebratory drinking party, still carrying the stench of cadavers and dead creatures mixed with food.
source_quote: That night, Romag hosted a celebratory drinking party in the newly cleaned banquet hall, which still carried the stench of cadavers and dead creatures mixed with food.

subject: the chest of weapons
fact: The chest of weapons is the shipment stolen from Dren Halveth's company by the Crimson Reapers, which the Reapers claim is temple property.
source_quote: Dren revealed that a shipment of weapons belonging to his company had been stolen by the Crimson Reapers, who occupied the room next door.

subject: Crimson Reapers
fact: The Crimson Reapers are a group operating behind the four elemental temples, claiming temple property, and demanding Dren join them or die by midnight.
source_quote: The party realized the Crimson Reapers worked for a deeper organization behind the four elemental temples, not one of the four temples directly.

subject: the room next door
fact: The room next door is the location occupied by the Crimson Reapers, where the chest of weapons was taken and where Calmer went to negotiate.
source_quote: Dren revealed that a shipment of weapons belonging to his company had been stolen by the Crimson Reapers, who occupied the room next door.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple is actively recruiting the Broken Blades in Nulb, offering a large sum of money and claiming the Earth Temple uses recruits as cannon fodder.
source_quote: Dren expressed skepticism, noting the Water Temple was offering a large sum of money and claiming the Earth Temple just used recruits as cannon fodder.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple is recruiting the Broken Blades in Nulb, sending the party personally to secure them, and offering gold and territory in exchange for loyalty.
source_quote: The party emphasized they had just claimed new territory and were willing to share it with the Broken Blades.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag claimed another portion of the cleared territory for himself after assigning the new territory to the Broken Blades.
source_quote: He announced that the new territory would be given to the mercenaries, who would report to the party, though he claimed another portion of the cleared territory for himself.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch kept Wat on his payroll despite Wat's apparent loyalty to the Water Temple, stating that until complete power was secured, everyone had to work together.
source_quote: When Calmer questioned Dick Rentsch about keeping Wat on his payroll despite his apparent loyalty to other factions, Dick responded that until they had secured complete power, everyone had to work together.

subject: back room
fact: The back room is the private space in the Watersteide Hostel where Dick Rentsch met with the party to discuss recruiting the Broken Blades.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch, who took them to his back room to discuss business privately.

subject: Dren Halveth
fact: Dren Halveth agreed to join the Earth Temple in exchange for one hundred gold pieces to help set up their new business after being convinced by the party's arguments.
source_quote: Impressed by these arguments, Dren agreed to join the Earth Temple in exchange for one hundred gold pieces to help set up their new business.

subject: the orb
fact: The orb is the key to the vault that opened the deep places within the temple, and Romag stated such information needed to be earned before being revealed.
source_quote: The orb was also the key to the vault that opened the deep places within the temple. When asked what was in the vault, Romag stated that such information needed to be earned—he did not yet trust them enough to reveal everything.

subject: the vault
fact: The vault is the deep place within the temple that can be opened only with the orb, and its contents remain unrevealed until trust is earned.
source_quote: The orb was also the key to the vault that opened the deep places within the temple. When asked what was in the vault, Romag stated that such information needed to be earned—he did not yet trust them enough to reveal everything.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag revealed that the key to unlocking the temple's central driving power is the orb, and that he had shared brandy with the party after considering their loyalty.
source_quote: He pulled out some brandy and shared it with them. He revealed that the key was an orb...
